tools.name: find_indicator
tools.description: Use FIRST, before any other tool, whenever a question names a subject rather than an indicator id — "stunting", "land inequality", "bank credit". Returns matching indicator ids with their unit, source, vintage, caveat and district coverage. Every other tool needs an id from here; ids are not guessab

tools.name: get_district
tools.description: Use when the question is about one named place — "tell me about Bilaspur", "what is Pune's literacy rate". tools.name: compare_districts
tools.description: Use when the question names two or more places and asks how they differ — "compare Pune and Nagpur on literacy and bank credit". One call, not one get_district per district. Write an ambiguous name as "Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh".

tools.name: rank_districts

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "rank_districts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
